title: AI spending fervor is comparable to industrial push during World War 2
title_zh: 人工智能支出热度堪比第二次世界大战期间的工业推动力
summary: Zacks Investment Research senior stock strategist Andrew Rocco comments on the heightened spending seen across the AI trade — particularly in the memory chip landscape amid shortages — comparing to prior buildouts in American history.

title: Taiwan's MediaTek says it supports both TSMC and Intel's advanced packaging technologies
title_zh: 台湾联发科表示支持台积电和英特尔的先进封装技术
summary: Taiwan chip designer MediaTek said on Friday it supports both TSMC's and Intel's ‌advanced packaging technologies, allowing customers to choose between the ‌two approaches.

title: Dell rallies about 40% on strong Nvidia‑powered AI server demand
title_zh: 戴尔因 Nvidia 驱动的 AI 服务器需求强劲而上涨约 40%
summary: Shares of Dell Technologies soared nearly 40% in premarket trading on Friday, after robust demand for its Nvidia-powered ‌AI servers prompted the company to raise its annual revenue ‌and profit forecasts.
summary_zh: 戴尔科技集团 (Dell Technologies) 的股价在周五盘前交易中飙升近 40%，此前对其搭载 Nvidia 的 AI 服务器的强劲需求促使该公司提高了年度收入和利润预测。
